description: Find BC Parks campsites that fit your dates, rig, and site needs, and check live day-pass status by park, access area, and time slot. Compare complete-stay availability, park calendars, weather, and official advisories, then open the official BC Parks search flow. Results include observation times and source links. Parks Open is independent and never selects, books, holds, or takes payment for campsites or passes.

defaultPrompt: Find campsites near Vancouver next weekend for a 32-foot RV with electrical service for the complete stay.
Show Golden Ears availability for eight weeks, then check alerts and weather for the best weekend.
